verdict.rationale: Figma documents an official MCP server, including a remote server that connects directly to Figma files without the desktop app. Its tools let agents read design context and variables, generate code from frames, and write native content back to the canvas. A probe confirms the first-party MCP server documentation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting through the server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Figma's remote MCP server makes it possible to connect directly to your Figma files without needing to install Figma's desktop app.
provides tools for reading designs out of Figma, writing designs into Figma, connecting designs to your codebase, and building generative plugins and shaders
enabling agents to write native Figma content back to the canvas
